GAP LE Vendor Exported Functions

group GAP_LE_VENDOR_Exported_Functions

GAP LE vendor command Exported Functions.

Functions

void gap_vendor_register_cb(P_FUN_GAP_APP_CB vendor_callback)

Register callback to vendor command, when messages in GAP_VENDOR_MSG_TYPE happens, it will callback to APP.

Example usage 

void app_le_gap_init(void)
 {
     ......
     gap_vendor_register_cb(app_gap_vendor_callback);
 }
 void app_gap_vendor_callback(uint8_t cb_type, void *p_cb_data)
 {
     T_GAP_VENDOR_CB_DATA cb_data;
     memcpy(&cb_data, p_cb_data, sizeof(T_GAP_VENDOR_CB_DATA));
     APP_PRINT_INFO1("app_gap_vendor_callback: cb_type is %d", cb_type);
     switch (cb_type)
     {
     case GAP_MSG_GAP_VENDOR_SET_ANT_CTRL:
         APP_PRINT_INFO1("GAP_MSG_GAP_VENDOR_SET_ANT_CTRL: cause 0x%x",
                         cb_data.gap_vendor_cause.cause);
         break;
     default:
         break;
     }
     return;
 }

参数:

vendor_callback -- [in] Callback function provided by the APP to handle GAP_VENDOR_MSG_TYPE messages sent from the GAP.

  • NULL -> Not send GAP_VENDOR_MSG_TYPE messages to APP.

  • Other -> Use application defined callback function.

T_GAP_CAUSE le_vendor_adv_3_data_enable(bool enable)

Enable 3 advertising channel advertising data. Set 3 adv data please refer to le_vendor_adv_3_data_set.

If sending request operation is successful, the enabling result will be returned by callback registered by le_register_app_cb with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_VENDOR_ADV_3_DATA_ENABLE.

Example usage 

void gap_vendor_test(bool enable)
{
    ...
    cause = le_vendor_adv_3_data_enable(enable);
    return cause;
}
T_APP_RESULT app_gap_callback(uint8_t cb_type, void *p_cb_data)
{
    T_APP_RESULT result = APP_RESULT_SUCCESS;
    T_LE_CB_DATA cb_data;
    memcpy(&cb_data, p_cb_data, sizeof(T_LE_CB_DATA));
    APP_PRINT_TRACE1("app_gap_callback: cb_type %d", cb_type);
    switch (cb_type)
    {
    ...
    case GAP_MSG_LE_VENDOR_ADV_3_DATA_ENABLE:
        APP_PRINT_INFO1("GAP_MSG_LE_VENDOR_ADV_3_DATA_ENABLE: cause 0x%x",
                        p_data->le_cause.cause);
        break;
    }
    ...
}

参数:

enable -- [in]

  • true: Enable each ADV channel with different data.

  • false: Disable each ADV channel with different data.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Sending request operation is successful.

  • Others -- Sending request operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending request.

T_GAP_CAUSE le_vendor_adv_3_data_set(T_GAP_ADV_VENDOR_DATA_TYPE type, uint8_t len, uint8_t *p_data)

Set different advertising data or scan response data in 3 advertising channels.

This API is used to set 38 or 39 channel data, set 37 channel data please use le_adv_set_param with parameter GAP_PARAM_ADV_DATA or GAP_PARAM_SCAN_RSP_DATA. It is necessary to enable 3 ADV data with le_vendor_adv_3_data_enable.

If sending request operation is successful, the setting result will be returned by callback registered by le_register_app_cb with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_VENDOR_ADV_3_DATA_SET.

Example usage 

T_GAP_CAUSE gap_vendor_test(T_USER_CMD_PARSED_VALUE *p_parse_value)
{
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause;
    T_GAP_ADV_VENDOR_DATA_TYPE type = (T_GAP_ADV_VENDOR_DATA_TYPE)p_parse_value->dw_param[0];
    uint8_t len = p_parse_value->dw_param[1];
    uint8_t value = p_parse_value->dw_param[2];
    uint8_t adv_data[31];
    if (len > GAP_MAX_ADV_LEN)
    {
        return (RESULT_ERR);
    }
    memset(adv_data, value, len);

    cause = le_vendor_adv_3_data_set((T_GAP_ADV_VENDOR_DATA_TYPE)type, len, adv_data);
    return (T_GAP_CAUSE)cause;
}
T_APP_RESULT app_gap_callback(uint8_t cb_type, void *p_cb_data)
{
    T_APP_RESULT result = APP_RESULT_SUCCESS;
    T_LE_CB_DATA cb_data;
    memcpy(&cb_data, p_cb_data, sizeof(T_LE_CB_DATA));
    APP_PRINT_TRACE1("app_gap_callback: cb_type %d", cb_type);
    switch (cb_type)
    {
    ...
    case GAP_MSG_LE_VENDOR_ADV_3_DATA_SET:
        APP_PRINT_INFO2("GAP_MSG_LE_VENDOR_ADV_3_DATA_SET: type %d, cause 0x%x",
                        p_data->p_le_vendor_adv_3_data_set_rsp->type,
                        p_data->p_le_vendor_adv_3_data_set_rsp->cause);
        break;
    ...
}

参数:

  • type -- [in] LE vendor advertising data type T_GAP_ADV_VENDOR_DATA_TYPE.

  • len -- [in] The number of significant octets in the advertising data.

  • p_data -- [in] Pointer to data to write.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Sending request operation is successful.

  • Others -- Sending request operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending request.

T_GAP_CAUSE le_ae_coding_scheme(T_GAP_AE_CODING_SCHEME coding_scheme)

Configure coding scheme of LE Coded PHY when device uses LE Advertising Extensions.

If sending request operation is successful, the setting result will be returned by callback registered by le_register_app_cb with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_AE_CODING_SCHEME.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    le_ae_coding_scheme(GAP_AE_CODING_SCHEME_S8);
}
T_APP_RESULT app_gap_callback(uint8_t cb_type, void *p_cb_data)
{
    T_APP_RESULT result = APP_RESULT_SUCCESS;
    T_LE_CB_DATA cb_data;
    memcpy(&cb_data, p_cb_data, sizeof(T_LE_CB_DATA));
    APP_PRINT_TRACE1("app_gap_callback: cb_type %d", cb_type);
    switch (cb_type)
    {
    ...
    case GAP_MSG_LE_AE_CODING_SCHEME:
        APP_PRINT_INFO1("GAP_MSG_LE_AE_CODING_SCHEME: cause 0x%x",
                        cb_data->le_cause.cause);
    break;
    ...
}

备注

Advertiser should delete advertising set before changing coding scheme.

参数:

coding_scheme -- [in] Coding scheme of LE Coded PHY when device uses LE Advertising Extensions. Value is T_GAP_AE_CODING_SCHEME.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Sending request operation is successful.

  • Others -- Sending request operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending request.

T_GAP_CAUSE le_adv_set_tx_power(T_GAP_ADV_TX_POW_TYPE type, uint8_t tx_power_double)

Set the advertising tx power for the device, or reset advertising tx power to default value.

Applications can only call this API after Bluetooth Host is ready.

Explanation: If Bluetooth Host is ready, the application will be notified by message GAP_MSG_LE_DEV_STATE_CHANGE with new_state about gap_init_state which is configured as GAP_INIT_STATE_STACK_READY.

If sending request operation is successful, the setting result will be returned by callback registered by le_register_app_cb with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_ADV_SET_TX_POWER.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause;
    uint8_t type = GAP_ADV_TX_POW_SET_1M;
    uint8_t tx_power_double = 0x80;
    cause = le_adv_set_tx_power((T_GAP_ADV_TX_POW_TYPE)type, tx_power_double);
}

T_APP_RESULT app_gap_callback(uint8_t cb_type, void *p_cb_data)
{
    T_APP_RESULT result = APP_RESULT_SUCCESS;
    T_LE_CB_DATA cb_data;
    memcpy(&cb_data, p_cb_data, sizeof(T_LE_CB_DATA));
    APP_PRINT_TRACE1("app_gap_callback: msgType %d", cb_type);
    switch (cb_type)
    {
    ...
    case GAP_MSG_LE_ADV_SET_TX_POWER:
         APP_PRINT_INFO1("GAP_MSG_LE_ADV_SET_TX_POWER: cause 0x%x",
                     p_data->le_cause.cause);
         break;
    ...
    }
}

备注

Different types of IC support different tx power levels. For the actual supported levels, please refer to the IC manual and related documentation.

The resolution of tx power is 0.5 dBm, not 1 dBm. Therefore, when setting the tx_power_double parameter, it should be set to twice the actual tx power.

参数:

  • type -- [in] ADV tx power type T_GAP_ADV_TX_POW_TYPE.

  • tx_power_double -- [in] Twice the actual tx power.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Sending request operation is successful.

  • Others -- Sending request operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending request.

T_GAP_CAUSE le_vendor_one_shot_adv(uint8_t guard_slot, uint16_t guard_usec, uint16_t wait_usec)

Trigger one shot advertising.

Applications can only call this API after Bluetooth Host is ready.

Explanation: If Bluetooth Host is ready, the application will be notified by message GAP_MSG_LE_DEV_STATE_CHANGE with new_state about gap_init_state which is configured as GAP_INIT_STATE_STACK_READY.

If sending request operation is successful, the setting result will be returned by callback registered by le_register_app_cb with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_VENDOR_ONE_SHOT_ADV.

Example usage 

static T_USER_CMD_PARSE_RESULT cmd_oneshot(T_USER_CMD_PARSED_VALUE *p_parse_value)
{
    uint8_t guard_slot = p_parse_value->dw_param[0];
    uint16_t guard_usec = p_parse_value->dw_param[1];
    uint16_t wait_usec = p_parse_value->dw_param[2];
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause;

    cause = le_vendor_one_shot_adv(guard_slot, guard_usec, wait_usec);
    return (T_USER_CMD_PARSE_RESULT)cause;
}
T_APP_RESULT app_gap_callback(uint8_t cb_type, void *p_cb_data)
{
    T_APP_RESULT result = APP_RESULT_SUCCESS;
    T_LE_CB_DATA cb_data;
    memcpy(&cb_data, p_cb_data, sizeof(T_LE_CB_DATA));
    APP_PRINT_TRACE1("app_gap_callback: cb_type %d", cb_type);
    switch (cb_type)
    {
    ...
    case GAP_MSG_LE_VENDOR_ONE_SHOT_ADV:
        APP_PRINT_INFO1("GAP_MSG_LE_VENDOR_ONE_SHOT_ADV: cause 0x%x",
                        p_data->le_cause.cause);
        break;
    }
    ...
}

备注

Trigger advertising after guard_slot * 625 + guard_usec + wait_usec(us).

This function cannot be used if advertising type is connectable high duty cycle directed advertising.

参数:

  • guard_slot -- [in] The delay time to trigger advertising in units of 625us, range: 0~224.

  • guard_usec -- [in] The delay time to trigger advertising in units of us, range: 0~65535.

  • wait_usec -- [in] The delay time to trigger advertising in units of us, range: 0~65535.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Sending request operation is successful.

  • Others -- Sending request operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending request.

T_GAP_CAUSE le_vendor_set_rem_min_sca(T_GAP_SCA_FIELD_ENCODING min_sca)

Set minimum remote SCA.

Applications can only call this API after Bluetooth Host is ready.

Explanation: If Bluetooth Host is ready, the application will be notified by message GAP_MSG_LE_DEV_STATE_CHANGE with new_state about gap_init_state which is configured as GAP_INIT_STATE_STACK_READY.

Set Min_sca to compare with M_sca sent by master (carried in CONNECT_REQ pdu). The finally used master sca is set to minimum(Min_sca, M_sca). The default Min_sca is 7. The setting is used by all links in slave role, can set when boot up or link exist, and will reset to default value when HCI_RESET.

If sending request operation is successful, the setting result will be returned by callback registered by le_register_app_cb with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_VENDOR_SET_MIN_REM_SCA.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause;
    T_GAP_SCA_FIELD_ENCODING index = GAP_SCA_76_TO_100_PPM;
    cause = le_vendor_set_rem_min_sca(index);
}
T_APP_RESULT app_gap_callback(uint8_t cb_type, void *p_cb_data)
{
    T_APP_RESULT result = APP_RESULT_SUCCESS;
    T_LE_CB_DATA cb_data;
    memcpy(&cb_data, p_cb_data, sizeof(T_LE_CB_DATA));
    APP_PRINT_TRACE1("app_gap_callback: cb_type %d", cb_type);
    switch (cb_type)
    {
    ...
    case GAP_MSG_LE_VENDOR_SET_MIN_REM_SCA:
        APP_PRINT_INFO1("GAP_MSG_LE_VENDOR_SET_MIN_REM_SCA: cause 0x%x",
                        p_data->le_cause.cause);
        break;
    }
    ...
}

参数:

min_sca -- [in] Minimum SCA T_GAP_SCA_FIELD_ENCODING.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Sending request operation is successful.

  • Others -- Sending request operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending request.

T_GAP_CAUSE le_set_conn_tx_power(uint8_t conn_id, bool reset, uint8_t tx_power_double)

Set the link tx power for the device.

Set LE link tx power. Or reset link tx power to default value. Tx power is set to default every time a link is connect. Use this API after the link is connected.

If sending request operation is successful, the setting result will be returned by callback registered by le_register_app_cb with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_SET_CONN_TX_PWR.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
   T_GAP_CAUSE cause;
   uint8_t conn_id = 0;
   bool reset = false;
   uint8_t tx_power_double = 0;

   cause = le_set_conn_tx_power(conn_id, reset, tx_power_double);
}

T_APP_RESULT app_gap_callback(uint8_t cb_type, void *p_cb_data)
{
    T_APP_RESULT result = APP_RESULT_SUCCESS;
    T_LE_CB_DATA cb_data;
    memcpy(&cb_data, p_cb_data, sizeof(T_LE_CB_DATA));
    APP_PRINT_TRACE1("app_gap_callback: msgType %d", cb_type);
    switch (cb_type)
    {
    ...
       case GAP_MSG_LE_SET_CONN_TX_PWR:
           APP_PRINT_INFO1("GAP_MSG_LE_SET_CONN_TX_PWR: cause 0x%x",
                           p_data->le_cause.cause);
           break;
    ...
    }
}

备注

Different types of IC support different tx power levels. For the actual supported levels, please refer to the IC manual and related documentation.

The resolution of tx power is 0.5 dBm, not 1 dBm. Therefore, when setting the tx_power_double parameter, it should be set to twice the actual tx power.

参数:

  • conn_id -- [in] Connection ID.

  • reset -- [in] Whether to reset to default value.

  • tx_power_double -- [in] Twice the actual tx power.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Sending request operation is successful.

  • Others -- Sending request operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending request.

T_GAP_CAUSE gap_vendor_cmd_req(uint16_t op, uint8_t len, uint8_t *p_param)

Send vendor command.

If sending request operation is successful, the setting result will be returned by callback registered by gap_register_app_cb with msg type GAP_MSG_VENDOR_CMD_RSP.

A vendor command may trigger vendor-specific event (whether a vendor-specific event is generated depends on the specific vendor command). If cause in T_GAP_VENDOR_CMD_RSP is 0 (success) and a vendor-specific event is generated, APP will be notified by callback with msg type GAP_MSG_VENDOR_EVT_INFO.

Example usage 

//send vendor command
void test(void)
{
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause = GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS;
    uint16_t opcode;
    uint8_t param[2];
    param[0] = 0;
    param[1] = 0;
    cause = gap_vendor_cmd_req(opcode, 2, param);
}

//register callback, and handle response
void app_le_gap_init(void)
{
    ......
    gap_register_app_cb(app_gap_common_callback);
}

void app_gap_common_callback(uint8_t cb_type, void *p_cb_data)
{
    T_GAP_CB_DATA cb_data;
    memcpy(&cb_data, p_cb_data, sizeof(T_GAP_CB_DATA));
    APP_PRINT_INFO1("app_gap_common_callback: cb_type %d", cb_type);
    switch (cb_type)
    {
    case GAP_MSG_VENDOR_CMD_RSP:
        APP_PRINT_INFO3("GAP_MSG_VENDOR_CMD_RSP: command 0x%x, cause 0x%x, param_len %d",
                    cb_data.p_gap_vendor_cmd_rsp->command,
                    cb_data.p_gap_vendor_cmd_rsp->cause,
                    cb_data.p_gap_vendor_cmd_rsp->param_len);
        break;
   ......
}

参数:

  • op -- [in] Opcode of command.

  • len -- [in] Length of parameters.

  • p_param -- [in] Pointer to parameters to write.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Sending request operation is successful.

  • Others -- Sending request operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending request.

bool gap_vendor_le_set_host_feature(uint16_t bit_number, uint8_t bit_value)

Set vendor feature of LE Host.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    bool retval = gap_vendor_le_set_host_feature(bit_number, bit_value);
}

参数:

  • bit_number -- [in]

    • 2 : Whether to skip reading remote features when the connection is established. Disabled by default, the local device reads remote features when the connection is established.

  • bit_value -- [in]

    • 0 : Disable.

    • 1 : Enable.

返回值:

  • true -- Sending request operation is successful.

  • false -- Sending request operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending request.
